# InChI static audit inventory

Pinned identities: official InChI v1.07.5 (`third_party/InChI/INCHI-1-SRC/INCHI_BASE/src/bcf_s.h:52`); RDKit Release_2026.03.1 (`third_party/rdkit/CMakeLists.txt`). Active official target assumptions: GCC/Linux LP64, `COMPILE_ANSI_ONLY`, `TARGET_API_LIB`; verify per-function conditional branches.

Production functions: **2019 total; 411 audited; 1608 pending**. Seventy-three stable-ID rows below are retained as `#[cfg(test)]` evidence-only fixtures and excluded from the production denominator and audit action queue.. Closures with algorithmic work are recorded as regions under their owning function. Three same-name C functions lack inline Rust source anchors and are explicitly identified below. Every other unanchored body is provisionally classified as Rust-only support, with source caller/macro semantics to verify during audit. Source endpoints have been resolved from pinned local files.

**Shared cost correction (INCHI-AUDIT-0001):** Earlier pointer-bearing generated-default rows and evidence state "cost equivalent" or "no finding" because their loop/allocation shape was equivalent. That conclusion is superseded on the storage-footprint and initialization-traffic axis: each Rust source pointer carries allocation identity, an option tag, and a separate offset where pinned C carries one native pointer. These completed function audits now inherit finding INCHI-AUDIT-0001; a row's "no finding" means no additional function-specific difference. Non-pointer zero-state conclusions are unaffected. The shared pointer-default panic quarantines mutable and const defaults; direct pointer constructors and downstream cost remain for their own actions.

Rust preserves the same short-circuit gates, pair order, count increments, overflow code and zero default for other modes. **Performance/complexity:** both traverse the same path and perform O(existing endpoint pairs) dedup scan per candidate, O(1) local state and no body allocation; Rust repeatedly clones full vertices for scalar cap/flow reads and resolves each pair element through the virtual heap, inherited INCHI-AUDIT-0032/0033/0034. No independent extra traversal or finding.
